activity.notes: Lázaro Cárdenas del Río (21 May 1895 – 19 October 1970) served as constitutional president of Mexico from 1 December 1934 through 30 November 1940. His government implemented agrarian reform and the 1938 oil expropriation, and ended the Maximato. Reuse existing Mexico polity. Official national archival records control death date rather than the erroneous September date in the indexed NamuWiki entry.
